title: Cabinet
summary: The shell of a drawer cabinet: rails for drawers that each hold a grid of bins. Cabinets stack on each other and on baseplates, and take bins or crates on top.

groups.title: Drawers
groups.help: Each drawer holds a grid of bins: its width and depth in 42 mm squares and the bin height in 7 mm units. The cabinet is sized around the drawers.

groups.title: Walls
groups.help: Thicker walls and plates make a stiffer cabinet; thinner ones print faster and lighter.

groups.title: Stacking
groups.help: Feet underneath and pockets on top use the Gridfinity grid, so cabinets stack, sit on a baseplate, and take bins or crates on top.

params.label: Drawer width
params.help: Grid squares inside each drawer, across the front.

params.label: Drawer depth
params.help: Grid squares inside each drawer, front to back.

params.label: Bin height
params.help: Height of the bins each drawer holds, in 7 mm units.

params.label: Drawers
params.help: Number of drawers, stacked one above the other.

params.label: Floor thickness
params.help: Solid floor under the bottom drawer.

params.label: Top thickness
params.help: Solid top above the top drawer (under the stacking pockets).

params.label: Solid back
params.help: Turn off for an open back with an 8 mm frame. The frame still stops the drawers.

params.label: Feet
params.help: Gridfinity feet under the cabinet, so it locks onto a baseplate or another cabinet. Turn off for a flat bottom.

params.label: Stacking top
params.help: Baseplate pockets on top, so cabinets, crates and bins stack on it. Turn off for a flat top.
